ostrzezenia.tekst: There are no validated processes for vegetables and herbs in oil made at home; in the USA, the rules for such products apply only to commercial processors.
Appearance, smell and taste cannot tell you whether vegetables in oil carry a botulism hazard.
The acidification method for homemade garlic and herb oils was developed only for garlic, basil, oregano and rosemary; it does not cover other vegetables or herbs, such as peppers or mushrooms.

akapity: Peppers, garlic, mushrooms and eggplant have been involved in botulism outbreaks from vegetables and herbs in oil, mostly homemade products.
